=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md:4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sentence "This applies only when no allow rule could match the command" contradicts the clause "are refused with steps to rewrite them instead".
  WHY: The guard denies allow-rule-matching commands in Auto mode, so the description is factually incorrect and misinforms operators.
- tests/claude_template_drift.py:129 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `stripped.replace(f',\n      "{rule}"', "", 1)` relies on hardcoded indentation of 6 spaces.
  WHY: If `settings.json` is reformatted, the replace fails and `settings_match_template` returns False even when the template matches, causing false-positive parity failures.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:2002-2009 (and corresponding line in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A `for` loop that never calls `gh api` reaches the unconditional `_shell_rewrite_hazard` check, and in Auto mode it is denied with the `_AUTO_SHAPE_DENY_SUFFIX` text.
  WHY: The session is told to rewrite `gh api` calls that the command does not contain.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:1567, 1660, 1744 (test names) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The test names `test_allow_rule_covered_shape_doubts_still_ask_in_auto_mode`, `test_shape_doubts_under_any_allow_rule_still_ask_in_auto_mode`, `test_auto_mode_keeps_asks_when_settings_cannot_be_checked` and `test_auto_mode_hazard_that_could_hide_a_file_field_still_asks` are misleading.
  WHY: The bodies assert `DECISION_DENY` via `_assert_auto_shape_deny` but the names say "still_ask".
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run rewrote only the tail of the sentence ("still prompt" -> "are refused with steps to rewrite them instead") and left the scoping clause "This applies only when no allow rule could match the command" and the clause "Auto mode approves a command that matches an allow rule without running its safety check" untouched, so the paragraph is self-contradictory.
  WHY: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1908` computes `auto_shape_deny = payload.get("permission_mode") == AUTO_PERMISSION_MODE and not auto_mode`, and `auto_mode` is False precisely when an allow rule matched (lines 1900-1905). The shape branches return `DECISION_DENY` at lines 1930, 1939, 2004 and 2013 (same line numbers in `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py`). The text is folded verbatim into `CHANGELOG.md` by `scripts/assemble_changelog.py`, and the sibling fragment `changelog.d/8180-auto-mode-shape-denies.md` describes the same code correctly.
- tests/claude_template_drift.py:127-129 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: `settings_match_template()` strips the appended live-only rule with a literal six-space indentation (`stripped.replace(f',\n      "{rule}"', "", 1)`).
  WHY: A live `.claude/settings.json` with different indentation passes the JSON comparison at lines 117-125 but fails the text comparison, so the four parity call sites (`tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`, `tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py`, `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py`) report a mismatch that does not name the real cause. Suggested fix: `stripped = re.sub(r",\s*\"" + re.escape(rule) + r"\"", "", stripped, count=1)`, about 2 lines changed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sentence "This applies only when no allow rule could match the command" contradicts the later claim that commands matching an allow rule are refused with rewrite steps.
  WHY: The updated hook denies certain shape doubts in Auto mode when an allow rule could match, and the changelog is folded verbatim into release notes, so readers get conflicting instructions.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- changelog.d/auto-mode-hook-prompts.md:4 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The sentence is self-contradictory. It says the deny applies when the command does NOT match an allow rule (per `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1904`, `auto_shape_deny = ... and not auto_mode`), but then says commands an allow rule could match are "refused with steps to rewrite them instead".
  WHY: The fragment is folded verbatim into `CHANGELOG.md` and synced to consumers, so operators would conclude allow-rule-matching commands are now denied when they still pass through to the Auto-mode classifier. CLAUDE.md §23.H and the #8180 fragment document the behavior correctly.
- tests/claude_template_drift.py:129 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: `settings_match_template()` hardcodes six spaces of indentation in `stripped = stripped.replace(f',\n      "{rule}"', "", 1)`.
  WHY: A re-indent of `.claude/settings.json` makes the helper return False, and all four parity call sites (`tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2451`, `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:1117`, `tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py:261`, `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py:242`) fail with a mismatch that does not name the real cause. Suggested fix: `re.sub(r",\s*\"" + re.escape(rule) + r"\"", "", stripped, count=1)` (`re` is already imported at line 21).
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py (and workflow-templates twin):2002-2009 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: In `evaluate()`, the hazard branch (`hazard_auto_deny` return) appends `_AUTO_SHAPE_DENY_SUFFIX` whenever `hazard_auto_deny` is True, even if the command contains no `gh api` invocation.
  WHY: A `for` loop with `$'...'` quoting that never calls `gh api` gets the gh-api-specific rewrite steps, which mislead the session. Suggested fix: append the suffix only when `invocations` is non-empty or `_may_invoke_gh_api(command)` is true, about 3 lines changed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
